title: Nasdaq falls 4.5% in a week as AI debt fears hit tech, while Brent jumps to $109.86
short: Nasdaq falls 4.5% on AI fears; Brent jumps to $109.86
dek: US tech stocks had a rough week as investors questioned debt-funded AI spending. Hot inflation data rattled bonds, and oil climbed on Middle East supply fears.
card: Nasdaq −4.5%, S&P 500 −1.9%, Dow +0.7% for the week. Brent settled at $109.86. What it means for India on Monday.
